translations: towards Him the means and strive hard
puzzle.hint: A powerful address to the believers combining three essential commands: taqwa (consciousness of Allah), drawing closer to Him through righteous deeds, and striving earnestly in His path — with the promise of ultimate success.
puzzle.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱبْتَغُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ ٱلْوَسِيلَةَ وَجَـٰهِدُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
puzzle.verseEn: O you who have believed, fear Allāh and seek the means [of nearness] to Him and strive in His cause that you may succeed.
